jobPostingInfo.title: Program Manager - Developer Programs
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription: <p>NVIDIA is searching for a Program Manager to support our Developer Programs team in China. You will manage program logistics, coordinate cross-functional stakeholders, and drive operational excellence.</p><p><strong>What you&rsquo;ll be doing:</strong></p><ul><li>Own end-to-end program management for developer events</li><li>Coordinate with engineering, marketing, and partner teams</li><li>Track program metrics and report to leadership</li></ul><p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p><ul><li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience</li><li>3+ years of program or project management experience</li><li>Fluent Mandarin and professional English</li></ul>
